panels.title: Introduction
panels.markdownContent: This dashboard provides vitals about distributed installation of Owlpane. Select the namespace in which Owlpane is installed and navigate to the appropriate tabs. You can find details about these metrics in the [documentation](https://owlpane.ai/docs/expose-metrics/) Metrics expect Owlpane ingest/agent/SDK telemetry (see api/docs/observability/dashboard-metrics-catalog.md). For support reach out to hello@owlpane.ai
